items.html: (And the matter is that there is in none of them any discernment of a Partzuf and division of particular limbs as in these five Sefirot, which are KHB TN. And even though every Sefira is comprised of ten, it seems to me that just as the arm of a person, although it is comprised of the limbs of the body, and of all of them within it — as is known, for it has in it the veins of the head, and of the heart, and of the liver, and of the whole body, as is known to the physicians who let blood from it for the benefit of the sick of the whole body — nevertheless, the height in the arm is the aspect of Hesed. And so likewise in each and every Sefira. But in the five aforementioned Sefirot there is a Partzuf in each one of them, and all the particular limbs are in each one of them, for the entire Partzuf is revealed and clarified in each one of them. And all this is called Atzilut.)
